definitions.explanation: The home or residence where one lives.

examples.japanese: {自宅|じたく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しています→する：00392_suru⟧。
{自宅|じたく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}ったら→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'll call you when I get home.

examples.japanese: {自宅|じたく}⟦{療養|りょうよう}→療養：08207_ryouyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{自宅|じたく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me your home address.

examples.japanese: {自宅|じたく}⟦{待機|たいき}→待機：09677_taiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{命|めい}じられた→命じる：02309_meijiru⟧。
examples.english: I was ordered to stay at home.

notes:
{自宅|じたく} means one's own home, emphasizing ownership or personal residence.

Common collocations:
- {自宅|じたく}で{働|はたら}く (to work from home)
- {自宅|じたく}に{戻|もど}る (to return home)
- {自宅|じたく}{療養|りょうよう} (home rest/recovery)
- {自宅|じたく}{待機|たいき} (staying home, home standby)
- {自宅|じたく}{学習|がくしゅう} (studying at home)
- {自宅|じたく}{勤務|きんむ} (working from home)

Similar words:
- {家|いえ} / うち (home - casual)
- {住宅|じゅうたく} (housing, residence - general term)
- {居宅|きょたく} (residence - formal/legal)

Usage: {自宅|じたく} is somewhat formal. In casual conversation, {家|いえ} or うち is more common.
